executive_summary: Episode advances the microphone rigging theory by identifying Philip Goldsberry Jr. as the AV technician who placed Charlie's Rode Wireless Pro mic on the inside of his shirt on 9/10, supported by Sam Parker's video analysis and a timeline of tour mic placement. Soter Global Ministries, the Eastern European orphanage charity co-founded by Dr. Philip Goldsberry Sr. in 2006, is documented as a new node in the recurring TPUSA Eastern European trafficking theme. Contradictory artifact-anchored CPR accounts from Frank Turek, Brian Harpole, and Rob McCoy are inscribed as a discrete discrepancy.
